description: A little Mac app named after my cat. She walks onto your screen, sits down, and reminds you to step away from the computer and enjoy life.
author: Niia Bieliavtseva

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && mkdir -p dist/renderer/popup && cp src/renderer/popup/index.html src/renderer/popup/style.css dist/renderer/popup/ && cp -R src/renderer/popup/sprites dist/renderer/popup/
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --mac --publish never
